title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_a_concise_history_of_computers_smartphones_and_th_by_ernie_dainow_3at7j (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_a_concise_history_of_computers_smartphones_and_th_by_ernie_dainow_3at7j' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including potential unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of compromise, complete remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets from a separate, trusted system.
